title: Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act 1998

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act 1998
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IX OF 1998
ACT IX OF 1998
PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH
INSTITUTIONS ACT, 1998
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Act may
be called the Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act, 1998.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act 1998
sections.description:
Establishment of the institutions

ACT IX OF 1998
ACT IX OF 1998
PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH
INSTITUTIONS ACT, 1998
2. Establishment of the
Institutions.‑‑‑(1) The Government may by notification‑‑
(a) establish such Medical Institutions and Health
Institutions as it may deem fit; or
(b) apply this Act to any existing Medical
Institution or Health Institution.
(2) The notified Medical Institution shall be a body
corporate, having perpetual succession and common seal, with power, to acquire,
hold and dispose of property, and may by its name sue and be sued.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act 1998
sections.description:
Objects

ACT IX OF 1998
ACT IX OF 1998
PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH
INSTITUTIONS ACT, 1998
3. Objects.‑‑‑The
objects of the institution shall be‑‑
(a) to undertake all functions required for providing
medical education and training and health facilities to the people; and
(b) to perform such other functions as are assigned
to it ‑ by toe Government.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act 1998
sections.description:
Administration of the institutions

ACT IX OF 1998
ACT IX OF 1998
PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH
INSTITUTIONS ACT, 1998
4. Administration
of the Institutions.‑---‑(1) The administration and management
of the affairs of a Medical Institution shall vest in the Management Committee
which, shall be appointed by the Government in accordance with the provisions
of this Act.
(2) The administration and management of a Health
Institution shall, subject to the directions of the Government, vest in such
body or person as may be notified.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act 1998
sections.description:
Management committee

ACT IX OF 1998
ACT IX OF 1998
PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH

5. Management Committee.‑‑‑(1) The
Management Committee of a Medical Institution shall comprise the following:‑‑
.
(a) Chief Executive Chairman
(b) Dean/Principal of Medical Member
institute concerned
(c) Medical Superintendent Member/Secretary
(In

more than one
Medical
Superintendents
are
Members, the senior
most
Superintendent shall
act
as Secretary and he
alone
shall have the right
of
vote as Member).
(d) Five non‑official Members Members
proposed by the Members listed
at (a), (b) and (c) and
approved
by the Government.
(2) A non‑official Member shall unless the
Government otherwise directs, hold office `for a period of three years and
shall be eligible for re appointment.
(3) No act or proceeding of the Management Committee
shall be invalid merely on the ground of the existence of any vacancy or defect
in the constitution of the Management Committee.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act 1998
sections.description:
Chief executive

ACT IX OF 1998
ACT IX OF 1998
PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH
INSTITUTIONS ACT, 1998
6. Chief Executive. ‑‑‑(I) The
Government shall appoint a whole time Chief Executive of the Medical
Institution possessing such qualifications and on such terms and conditions
notwithstanding anything contained in any law, as the Government may determine.
(2) The Chief Executive of the Institution shall
exercise such powers and perform such functions as may be prescribed.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act 1998
sections.description:
Appointment of officers and employees

ACT IX OF 1998
ACT IX OF 1998
PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH
INSTITUTIONS ACT, 1998
7. Appointment
of Officers and Employees.‑‑(1) The Government may appoint such
persons in the service of the Institution as may be necessary on such terms and
conditions notwithstanding anything contained in any law, as it may determine.
(2) The Management Committee may appoint such persons
in the service of the Institution as may be necessary on such terms and
conditions as it may determine.
(3) All persons in the service of the Government of
the Punjab and serving in the Medical and Health Institutions in any capacity,
immediately before the issuance of a notification under section 2 of this Act,
may continue to serve in such Institutions unless they are reverted to their
parent Department.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act 1998
sections.description:
Committees

ACT IX OF 1998
ACT IX OF 1998
PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH
INSTITUTIONS ACT, 1998
8. Committees.‑‑‑The Managing
Committee may constitute such Committees as it may deem necessary for giving
effect to the provisions of this Act.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act 1998
sections.description:
Delegation of powers

ACT IX OF 1998
ACT IX OF 1998
PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH
INSTITUTIONS ACT, 1998
9. Delegation of Powers.‑‑‑The Managing Committee
may delegate to any person or a Committee any of its powers, duties or
functions.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act 1998
sections.description:
Funds

ACT IX OF 1998
ACT IX OF 1998
PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH
INSTITUTIONS ACT, 1998
10. Funds.‑‑‑(1) There shall be a
fund to be known by the name of the Institution which shall vest in the
Institution and to which shall be credited all sums received by the
Institution.
(2) The fund shall be ,kept in such custody and shall
be utilized and regulated in such manner as may be prescribed.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act 1998
sections.description:
Budget audit and accounts

ACT IX OF 1998
ACT IX OF 1998
PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH
INSTITUTIONS ACT, 1998
11. Budget, Audit and Accounts.‑‑‑(1)
The budget of a Medical Institution shall be approved and its accounts shall be
maintained and audited in such manner as may be prescribed.
(2) The Government may order financial, medical and
managerial monitoring and audit on quarterly basis through a third party
nominated by the Government and paid for by the Medical Institution and the
Management Committee shall comply with the directions which may be issued
thereon.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act 1998
sections.description:
Public servants

ACT IX OF 1998
ACT IX OF 1998
PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH
INSTITUTIONS ACT, 1998
12. Public Servants.‑‑‑All persons
acting or purporting to act in pursuance of any provision of this Act shall be
deemed to be public servants within the meaning of section 21 of the Pakistan
Penal Code, 1861.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act 1998
sections.description:
Rules

ACT IX OF 1998
ACT IX OF 1998
PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH
INSTITUTIONS ACT, 1998
13. Rules.‑‑‑The Government may
make Rules for carrying out the purposes of this Act.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act 1998
sections.description:
Regulations

ACT IX OF 1998
ACT IX OF 1998
PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH
INSTITUTIONS ACT, 1998
14. Regulations.
‑‑‑The Management Committee may, make Regulations not
inconsistent with the provisions of this Act and the Rules for carrying out the
purposes of this Act.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act 1998
sections.description:
Removal of difficulties

ACT IX OF 1998
ACT IX OF 1998
PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH
INSTITUTIONS ACT, 1998
15. Removal of Difficulties.‑‑‑If
any difficulty arises in giving effect to any of the provisions of this Act,
the Government may give such directions as it may consider necessary for the removal
of such difficulty.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act 1998
sections.description:
Repeal

ACT IX OF 1998
ACT IX OF 1998
PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH
INSTITUTIONS ACT, 1998
16. Repeal.‑‑The Punjab Medical and
Health Institutions Ordinance 1998 (XX of 1998) is hereby repealed.
